title: span settings

theme.description: Color theme used by the editor and surrounding interface.

tabSize.description: Number of spaces represented by one indentation level.

wordWrap.description: Wrap editor lines to the available viewport width.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used for settings completion and validation.

uiFontFamily.description: Font family for interface labels, controls and panels.

editorFontFamily.description: Font family for source code and text editing.

collapsePanelsOnDrag.description: Allow side panels to collapse when dragged beyond their minimum width.

markdownPreviewDefault.description: Open Markdown files in preview mode by default. Source and split views remain available.

formatOnSave.description: Run an available real language formatter before saving. Formatter failures preserve unsaved text.

keybindings.description: Portable shortcuts. Mod means Command on macOS and Control elsewhere. An empty array disables an action.

formatters.description: Per-language executable argv. Document text is sent on stdin. Arguments may contain {path}. Commands never run through a shell implicitly.

autoSave.description: When unsaved buffers are saved automatically. Off keeps saving explicit.

autoSaveDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before saving when autoSave is afterDelay.

zoomLevel.description: Explicit current-window zoom. Null keeps the global zoom preference.

files.autoSave.description: VS Code compatible alias for autoSave. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

files.autoSaveDelay.description: VS Code compatible alias for autoSaveDelay. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

editor.fontSize.description: VS Code compatible alias for fontSize. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

editor.fontFamily.description: VS Code compatible alias for editorFontFamily. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

editor.tabSize.description: VS Code compatible alias for tabSize. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

editor.formatOnSave.description: VS Code compatible alias for formatOnSave. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

window.zoomLevel.description: VS Code compatible alias for zoomLevel. Dotted keys take precedence over legacy flat keys within a scope.

editor.wordWrap.description: VS Code compatible wrap mode. bounded and wordWrapColumn are not implemented.

tabLimitEnabled.description: Limit open file tabs using the configured tab limit. Dirty, pending, pinned and visible active files are protected.

tabLimit.description: Maximum open file tabs. The limit applies across the workspace unless tabLimitPerGroup is enabled.

tabLimitPerGroup.description: Apply the tab limit to each editor group instead of the whole workspace.

workbench.editor.limit.enabled.description: VS Code compatible alias for tabLimitEnabled. Dotted keys take precedence within the same settings scope.

workbench.editor.limit.value.description: VS Code compatible alias for tabLimit. Dotted keys take precedence within the same settings scope.

workbench.editor.limit.perEditorGroup.description: VS Code compatible alias for tabLimitPerGroup. Dotted keys take precedence within the same settings scope.

description: Span supports the documented built-in settings and selected VS Code keys. Other keys are preserved in JSONC but have no effect.
